review_type: independent read-only source and supplied compile-log review; no builds or proof edits

checks.finding: operations selects opcode from the actual Nat x Nat x Instruction Labelled trace. XRuns.cons records decodeAt pre, actual step fuel and gas cost; there is no free desired-op annotation.

ReachesOps pairs XRuns and exact operation-list equality inside the same existential trace. Start fuel is f+1+ops.length and end fuel f+1. trans aligns the intermediate fuel before concatenating the actual traces.

singleton consumes actual Reaches 1, derives trace length one from XRuns.length, and inverts the actual XRuns constructor. The opcode is decodeAt the supplied initial state, not an arbitrary target opcode.

xRuns_symBlock_ops reproduces the existing sound symbolic-block construction with actual sitesOk/decode equality and xStepAt_symStep. Each induction step conses the actual head step and annotates that same trace; it does not obtain an unrelated run from erased reachability.

The final g/e witnesses are chosen outside the forall fuel and used in exactly the XRuns endpoint withGE s-prime g e. The recursive run uses the actual bumped state and withGE_withGE to align that endpoint; numeric gas lower bounds follow actual cost subtraction.

bounded_trace converts an existing ReachesLe witness to the requested actual fuel with positive remaining fuel and the same endpoints. ends_trace preserves the supplied actual Halt separately; the halt is not counted among the nonhalting XRuns labels.

scope_limits: No complete SYSTEM opcode enumeration, store count, dynamic gas sum or reference replay is established here.
weight is only finite-list arithmetic until supplied with a justified operation cost function and gas correspondence.
The symbolic-block theorem retains explicit actual sites, guard, gas and stack premises; it is a local companion rather than a whole-history transport theorem.
